research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Proximie is researching video labelling of surgical video through new surgical phase recognition methods called LoViT and SKiT, which use video clip supervision and multi scale temporal feature aggregation to classify surgical workflow states. They are also developing an apparatus for and method of obscuring information that transforms imaging feeds before transmission so only modified visual data leaves the device. Together these efforts focus on surgical video understanding and privacy preserving imaging transmission.

overview_description.description:
Proximie is a health technology platform that enables surgeons to virtually attend operating theaters to visually guide complex surgeries.

Proximie combines human expertise with the power of augmented reality, artificial intelligence, and machine learning to allow a surgeon to remotely watch an operation and use their hands to demonstrate things to the surgeon conducting the operation, who sees the remote surgeon on a screen. This platform aims to democratize access to the most up-to-date and skilled knowledge on surgery practice, by helping surgeons advise each other from different parts of the world.

The company was founded by Nadine Hachach-Haram in 2016 and is headquartered in London, England.

product.name: Proximie Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that connects operating rooms by integrating video, audio, and medical device data for real-time collaboration and data management.

product.name: Telepresence
product.description: Real-time video-based collaboration tools that allow remote surgical consultation and guidance during procedures.

product.name: Content Management (Video Library)
product.description: A centralized video library that stores and organizes recorded surgical procedures and specific steps for training and review.

product.name: Data & Insights
product.description: AI-powered analytics that provide insights from operating room data to improve workflows, device adoption, and surgical outcomes.

product.name: Proximie SDK
product.description: A software development kit enabling medical device companies to integrate real-time connectivity, data routing, and analytics into their products.

product.name: Px Kit
product.description: A hardware solution including wireless cameras and tablets for multi-view video capture and streaming in operating rooms.
